description:
Have Muse check the recorded cart before payment.

Muse checks the recorded cart against what the user asked for. The call waits for Muse's answer and resumes on its own. It returns whether the cart is confirmed, the change Muse asked for, or that Muse left it unconfirmed with a choice still open. Make a change Muse asked for, inspect the checkout again and call this again.

Muse confirms what is being bought once for this checkout, and that confirmation lets `checkout.commit` pay for it; the payment approval shows the user the total. If items, variants or quantities change, or delivery, dates, addresses, cancellation terms or other obligations materially change, record the new terms with `checkout.inspect` and call this again, even when the price stays within the approved total. Muse resolves the change within the user's request or asks the user when needed. A confirmed cart is not a payment approval: the user approves the payment in the payment approval `checkout.commit` shows when it places the order.

submit_ref.description: The reference of the control that places the order, or null to pay without placing it.

submit_look.description: The order control in words, as it appears on screen, when it has no reference: what it is, its visible text and where it sits. Null otherwise.

submit_within.description: With submit_look, an element reference to search inside; null otherwise.

use_wallet.description: True on a card checkout to pay with one of the user's wallet cards when checkout.inspect reports no card chosen and a wallet that can pay. The user picks the card in the payment approval. Null otherwise.
